title: Database engineering
blurb: How databases really work, with the Django ORM angle: design, speed, transactions, scaling and running them in production.

title: Python and Django core
blurb: The language and framework behaviour interviewers probe: Python internals, the Django request cycle, and authentication.

title: Behavioral and interview skills
blurb: How to tell your story: STAR answers with real numbers, and how interview loops are structured.

title: Data structures and algorithms
blurb: The coding rounds: arrays and hash maps, stacks, linked lists, sorting, trees, graphs, heaps, recursion and dynamic programming, each with runnable Python and the complexity you must be able to state.

title: Low-level design (object-oriented)
blurb: Turn a one-line prompt into classes and methods: SOLID, the design patterns that come up, and worked designs (parking lot, LRU cache, vending machine).

title: Computer science fundamentals
blurb: What Amazon lists beside data structures: operating systems, concurrency and internet topics. Processes, scheduling, virtual memory, threads, locks, deadlock and how HTTP works.

title: Scaling and distributed systems
blurb: How a system grows past one server: load balancing, caching, partitioning, queues, rate limits, retries and consensus. Every lesson is a diagram you step through.

title: Git, containers and deployment
blurb: Collaborate with Git, package with Docker, and ship through a pipeline to a real server.

title: Frontend engineering
blurb: How the browser runs your code, how React decides what to redraw, and how to make pages fast and usable by everyone.

title: Data engineering
blurb: Analytical SQL and the pipelines that move data reliably: batch, streaming, idempotency and quality.

title: DevOps and reliability
blurb: Measure services, set reliability targets, respond to incidents and manage infrastructure as code.

title: Machine learning engineering
blurb: Train and evaluate models honestly, then run them in production without silent failures.
